scope: Direct full-module context review; original inventoried site start positions joined to explicit semantic contexts, not independent expression-level or runtime certification. T temporal/state/order, P price/priority, N declaration/other.

contexts.meaning: Records, metadata and cache limits; immutable candle/reset/analysis/result containers, mutable candidate/cursors. No detection performed.
GREEN iff open<=close; equality green. Opposite direction delegates policy.
Retain market/index bounds; shared time and lower index; timeframe first two main timestamps difference else one second, positive required.

Inclusive main extrema; end-start>=16 uses shared index [start,end+1), reflected min queries original max and sign-negates (max mirror). Linear strict update retains earliest tie.
GREEN predecessor required at FirstRed-1 within start; contiguous run backward, max High.

Mode A invalidation level anchor else frozen leg floor; no boundary or main Low>=level false; strict low breach with no main breakout true. Both => exact lower first crossing positions.
No lower invalidation => true only when no breakout; absent breakout with invalidation true; both invalidation<=breakout wins same position.
Confirmed Reset race: candidate absent or no main breakout true; otherwise strict lower Low<confirmed bottom vs High>top, same absent and tie rule.
Post-break reset strictly after exact confirmation (+1us) to Break end exclusive; null analysis no search.
Directional detect delegates scan. Initialize Mode A SCANNING and empty results; optional initial cursor restores index/state/floor/anchor/candidate copy, not prior confirmation.

For each main strict Low<confirmed bottom; if WAITING race with Break. Reset first records main-only reset, clears confirmed and running state, enters fresh Mode A with RED reset anchor if applicable; skip rest of candle.
WAITING Mode A boundary invalidation discards candidate, new RED anchor origin invalidation, skips candle. Otherwise strict new Low updates bottom; High>top sets Break.
Refine bottom only if Break owns source and exact analysis available. Copy confirmation; first_only exits before future Reset/remainder. Establish confirmed bottom/First and running peak; Mode B.
Post-confirmation lower Reset records exact second and clears state; else RED Break itself seeds Mode B with entire main geometry in directional reference (different from Unified remainder helper).
Mode A new leg sets opening Low. First RED immediately after GREEN reset with Low>=reset Low seeds candidate; max prior green run/current high, prior green wins equal; else anchor RED.

GREEN->RED transition: discard invalidation anchor only when both prior/current Low<anchor. If anchor exists require current Low>=anchor; else current Low>=prior Low OR leg floor. Peak ties green source.
Pass creates Mode A with anchor and frozen leg floor; otherwise RED replaces anchor, DOJI/NEUTRAL clears; GREEN leaves.

Mode B RED starts candidate using running peak if >=current High; bottom range begins peak source+1 if earlier else current; strict update peak afterward. Retain unresolved initial cursor if requested.

Reflect OHLC via copy_negate, swap High/Low and GREEN/RED roles only; preserve time/index. Candidate swaps box values/sources, optional anchor/floor sign, other flags unchanged. Analysis mirrors event/extreme/source.
Reflected sequence cache lazy per position, slices materialize normalized indices; global view id+source identity.

Bearish detector uses bullish reference reflected sequences and index; time arrays unchanged. All analysis/reset/race methods mirror inputs/outputs, same tie rules; mirrored result reset levels negated.

Presentation clone; absent/invalid Break bounds unchanged. Only refine opposite edge if Break owns full main extreme. Initialize at First and scan complete preceding mains, strict update earliest owner. Invalid direction raises after initial checks.

Break lower scan updates opposite extreme BEFORE strict confirmation on same row. If no confirmation preserve clone. On hit freeze changed edge and owning main (Break for lower extreme); original candidate unchanged.
Lower index builds power-of-two min/max segment arrays and positions, optional OrderedDict crossing history; normalized Decimal leaves.
Parent aggregation null-side handling, <= min/>= max select left on equal; preserve earliest position.
Suffix refresh valid 0<=first<=old length<=new length<=capacity; no-op at length. Clear crossing history only if first<old length-1; refresh time suffix/leaves/ancestors.
Strict first_less excludes >=level, first_greater excludes <=level; min/max range wrappers half-open.
Range rejects invalid/empty bounds; iterative segments compare strict extreme or equal smaller position; no value or invalid position raises.
Clamp first-cross left>=0/right<=length; empty null. Choose history or native first.

History key left,level,exclude comparator. Cached hit returned only <right; covered>=right null; search from examined. Last candle unsettled; store hit only before last, else advance no-hit coverage through min(right,settled); return actual hit.
Crossing cache FIFO cap16384; not trading priority.
Root exclusion returns null. Segment decomposition left intervals immediate, right deferred reversed; descend earliest qualifying segment, left child unless excluded.
Prepared index requires exact candle identity, register; else id+identity reuse/build. Reflected index swaps min/max and strict direction with copy_negate.
Clear all market caches or remove supplied sequence IDs.
Chronology timeframe>=1 second, reuse prepared time arrays or construct; supplied lower or shared; fresh confirmation/reset/E extrema caches.
Direction delegate; main upper_bound-1, before first clamps to0 iff requested else error, no right-end guard. Lower bounds left-bisect and optional end length.
Reset key index/from First/second/display/timestamp/string level; confirmation key direction,bool flag,First/Break,string top/bottom, intrabar only when enabled.
Reset exact time cache, truthy second string first then display string parsed seconds, else timestamp attr.

Confirmation cache; start intrabar or Break open if flag true, else open; invalid start outside [open,end) resets open. First strict normalized lower High>top B/Low<bottom R; absent fallback Break open.

Canonical Order Mode A start max(start,anchor or First-1); extend backward through matching context tag; inclusive Break extreme, strict update first tie. Other mode requires number>1; inherit preceding opposite Reaction edge/source.
Behavior span from published clone and actual physical First/Break, First main, exact confirmation. Outer First strictly earlier, outer confirmation>=inner, box encloses inclusive.
Path extrema lower inclusive First..confirmation via left/right bisects; empty null; contained iff outer box covers both actual path extremes.
Assign metadata to original full reactions, numbering identity, blocked internal flags and First main times; no filtering.

Build both spans, use chronological containment index only exact naive datetimes. For each inner, outer temporal/box candidate then calculate path once; null path stops; first actual containing outer marks blocked.
Live containment entry immutable geometry/span/extremes, initialize empty matches and entries, update dirty0.
Dirty index valid inclusive count. At same ordinal reuse old if geometry key equal and Break<dirty; otherwise recompute span/path and mark changed only if entry differs.
Retain old matched pairs only valid indices and neither changed; changed inner checks every outer, unchanged checks changed outers. Block from all surviving/new pairs; apply metadata, commit.
A-stop opposite finder validates direction and tags; gate cache key gate index/end, exact gate_event unused.

First matching transition from max(1,gate) inclusive through end; absent cache null. Extend context run to0. Detection tuple cache context/end; first First>=gate; absent run Unified stopped at first eligible and cache selection.
Unified stores direction/bootstrap flags, lazy helpers, separate reaction/reset lists, geometry/gate caches and live cursors.
Lazy directional helper construction on demand.

Append Reaction: adjacent anchor and prior Reset/Break required; run opposite detector last reset..First, confirmed opposite Break==anchor. R with anchor High<=First High uses anchor bottom, B with anchor Low>=First Low uses anchor top.
Canonical opposite edge recomputed complete First..Break; if Break owns, refine exact confirmation when available. Append copy, always return true.
Append Reset main provenance with optional exact second; no separate search.
Directional refinement analysis; only replace opposite edge if current candle owns it; return analysis.

Unified same-candle reuse requires appropriate First color and analysis; any strict outward crossing after confirmation+1us through Break end forbids. Entire Break lower window used, not just remainder; absent null.
Top max High with negative epoch tie key (earliest), bottom min Low/time. Mode B First/sources current main, intrabar start main open; confirmed argument unused.
Initial selection retained cursor type asserted depending trend flag; trend bootstrap or reference scan first_only, mirror R. Nonretained selects trend bootstrap or directional first confirmation.

Trend bootstrap empty range null; initial fixed source/candidate/cursor or start. Update fixed extreme strictly before candidate; correct First tag creates Mode A with starting main floor/ceiling, skip same candle confirmation.
After First update opposite edge strictly; strict confirmation sets Break/refines and returns. No initial boundary invalidation; retain unresolved cursor end+1.
Direct post-Reset wrapper first element of search.

First candidates strictly after reset/beyond blocked_through with correct context tags. Build/scan; first confirmed returns with earlier-pending flag. Unresolved earlier does not block later; invalidation blocks through its main. Exhaustion null,true.

Geometry-only bounded search cache lookup (no writes here), iterate eligible Firsts, scan later mains for strict opposite edge update and confirmation; no invalidation. First completed in First traversal order.
Public geometry wrapper; Break indices cache by direction and list length only.
Order gate bounded limit; gate<start or >=limit null; key direction/index/limit/exact gate, copy cache hit.
Cache result shallow copy or null; evict oldest when >=32768.

Owner confirmation no later than gate: earlier Break or missing exact gate uses index<=gate; later false; same-main scan lower from intrabar/open through end; first strict hit<=gate; absent Break open<=gate.
Latest preceding confirmed Break via bisect_left; same-main owner only if confirmed. Default search gate+1; no owner earliest geometry labeled no-history.
Outer boundary extreme owner First..max(First,gate-1), gate High B/Low R. Lower race from exact gate or open through limit main end; empty null.

Strict outward vs continuation crossing; neither null. Restart if outward exists and <=continuation (equal position restart). Map restart event to selected main and search +1; null mapping or beyond limit rejects.
Earliest confirmed geometry; annotate decision kind. Continue missing anchor index OR value: latest reset strictly before First, extreme reset..First-1, assign anchor and leg boundary.
Earliest geometry scans mains, creates active candidate on proper color transition after max(start bound,start-1). Skip candidate on First itself, invalidate before confirming.
Update opposite edge strict; confirm strict, refine; maintain survivors. First main with confirmed candidates chooses min First, NOT earliest exact lower timestamp among same-main hits.

Direct candidate require First>reset, correct tags. Extend context run backward inclusive reset then prior First-color run. B First Low>=local floor/R First High<=ceiling; box from context..First, frozen outer anchor extreme reset..First-1.

Scan later main inclusive stop; calculate strict confirmation and boundary invalidation first, invalidated returns null,index. Update opposite edge; confirmation refines and returns; unresolved null,null.
Boundary absent/no strict breach false; strict breach no confirmation true. Both scan lower same main outward check first each row; if unresolved default invalidate.
Result exposes direction's native lists and bounds; public detect nonretaining.
Initial candidate via selected path, absent empty result; append; requested stop First>=gate exits. Initialize normal cursor after Break, running value/source Break.
Reanalyze initial Break; exact analysis extreme else opposite box reset level. Post-confirmation Reset records exact event and pending Break; otherwise same-candle reuse; scan normal.
Restore normal cursor, each main reset pending or strict prior edge breach; candidate Break strict; simultaneous reset and confirmation uses directional Reset-first lower race.
Reset selects pending or current main; retain first pre-reset checkpoint before recording, clear pending, suppress duplicate last Reset with same prior First.

If checkpoint candidate search with earlier pending flag, retain earliest_open if still open; otherwise direct same-direction. Missing confirmed structural breaks. Set Mode A and cross-direction flags false; append false-return branch exists although append always true.
Early stop on First>=gate. Update previous,next Break+1,running Break extreme; exact analysis reset level or box; post-Reset event forbids remainder candidate and sets pending; else reuse.

Normal active B candidate strict opposite-edge update then confirmation; exact refine/Reset level, post-Reset query BEFORE append, append and early stop; previous copy and running peak; exact Reset records pending or same-candle reuse.
Mirror R active normal path high update and strict breakdown; same refinement/append/reset/reuse order.
Absent candidate correct First tag creates Mode B with running peak/trough winning equality, opposite extreme starts source+1 if earlier else First. Update running strictly; advance index.
Retain earliest unresolved pre-reset checkpoint if any, else current cursor+counts; return native result.
Live seed validate direction, >=2 committed mains, copy lists, timeframe/options; validate extension, run retain cursor, release indexes finally, save checkpoints, processed count0.
Snapshots copy candidate records/reset list; construct full-window detector and release indexes helpers.

Extension positive timeframe and both nonempty; first indices0 or increment by1. Main positive time gap divisible by timeframe; lower strictly increasing. Lower first>=new main first and last<new main last+timeframe.
Advance commits, preview does not. Both empty returns snapshot. Validate against last committed, concatenate fresh lists.

No checkpoint: run initial continuation and processed new main count; else restore prior prefix by counts, clone cursor candidates, scan normal, processed len(full)-cursor index. Always release indexes.
Only commit updates lists/result/checkpoints/initial cursor/processed count; return snapshot regardless.
